title: Take the Attacker
setup: A bold black knight has leapt in to check your king — but did it look where it was landing?
hint: Your king could run, but why? The rudest answer to a check is to take the checker — can anything of yours reach it?
explanation:
## The Idea

The knight on d3 gives check, and a check has three answers: move the king, block the line, or capture the checker. A knight's check cannot be blocked, and here the capture is on offer.

Your pawn on c2 attacks b3 and d3, so {{cxd3}} removes the knight, ends the check and wins three points in one move. A king move would escape too, but it leaves the knight alive.
